info.name: Kamino Public Airdrop Private Credit API

items.docs: Returns current aggregate metrics and active loans for private credit vaults

params.name: start
params.description: Start date of the range (defaults to Unix epoch). Accepts ISO string or epoch in ms.

params.name: end
params.description: End date of the range (defaults to current time). Accepts ISO string or epoch in ms.

items.docs: Returns timeseries of private credit metrics. Frequency is automatically selected based on date range.
